requested_scope: COD4-7/11/14 actual acquisition/cost/replacement, no production changes
selected_route: Natural wood -> planks/sticks -> mu_mao -> crafted table/wood pick -> mined cobblestone -> shi_ge; then natural furnace/copper/iron and actual ordered original FTB tasks if reached. Retain last world to continue.
seed_selection: Fixed once before creating any world; no seed search or replacement for favourable resources.
world: New normal SURVIVAL, NORMAL difficulty, default game rules, structures enabled, bonus chest false, commands disabled. No user old save.
allowed_inputs: native survival block break/use packets with real reach and raycast
native inventory/container clicks using only acquired stacks
original FTB client submission/claim packet after prerequisite/resource validation
read-only client/server state/event logging and framebuffer screenshots
prohibited: artificial sleep or idle counted as 2-3h gameplay

record: UTC and monotonic wall time at every command and native event
active input ticks, GUI/crafting/inspection ticks, menu pause and idle ticks separately
first acquisition/equip/use/replacement timestamps and material deltas
clock_policy.claim: Report measured segment only; no target-hour padding. Six-stage 2-3h requirement remains open until actual relevant progression measured. No human-participation gate.

rawls_boundary: No spawn-rate/ecology campaign; only incidental naturally encountered entities/drop events in this route, retain exact origin; no claim ecological distribution verified.

bootstrap_inventory.cost: mu_mao =2 sticks+1 plank; shi_ge =that same mu_mao+2 cobble+1 stick; tong_dao =shi_ge+3 copper; tie_jian=tong_dao+3 iron
bootstrap_inventory.sources: Trees and naturally mined stone/ores using native tools; all production recipes unchanged.

bootstrap_inventory.cost: 1 silk=3 raw_silk=9 string; cloth chestplate8 silk=72 string; full set24silk=216string before other uses
bootstrap_inventory.sources: Existing string/spider/cobweb/loot and existing silk sources; natural source not yet attained, no supplied armour assumed.
Natural jade ore with iron tool; natural bamboo and preceding cloth. This transition is distinct from first wood-to-stone weapon replacement.

milestones.action: Read initial actual inventory and original welcome/manual grant; record untouched spawn/environment and root task.
Walk to visible reachable tree, mine by native held attack, physically collect item drops; craft planks/sticks/table/mu_mao via real menu clicks.
Place/use acquired crafting table; craft wooden pick, mine natural exposed stone/reachable staircase, collect cobble; consume actual old mu_mao in shi_ge. Record usability/cost/replacement time.

Make natural chest/furnace/charcoal/torches; submit only available original tasks with native client packets, record locked equipment tasks until actual iron pick/water bucket preconditions satisfied.
Continue visible natural copper/iron, food/shelter/lighting and survival risks; natural smelting, native weapon upgrades. Stop/pause on death, danger or missing route and preserve truthful result.
Natural cloth/jade/bamboo transition only when sources actually acquired; record full costs and first/last useful old gear actions. Do not declare 2-3h from first stone upgrade.

six_stage_inventory.route: 原第一章根任务→工作台/储物/火把/熔炉/铁镐/水桶→木矛/石戈/铜刀/铁剑→盾；布衣→竹甲
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 原生合成+顺序FTB提交；无任务进度预置。矿物、木材等QA供料逐次记账，水桶为明确入口夹具。

six_stage_inventory.route: 完整开局链→两种罗盘→青铜/朱砂/竹简/墨/图纸/精钢→奇门机括/钢索/连弩
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 原生库存连续扣料、目标提交；指南针和罗盘等若由QA供给必须逐项声明，不能记为自然取得。

six_stage_inventory.route: 原青铜剑→银剑→玉剑；布衣→竹甲→青铜甲→玉甲；原军粮→丝绸袋任务分支
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 任务前置单列预置；原装备前驱递归实付，银锭/玉/丝绸等明确QA提供。科举赠冠和真实饰品槽成长另验。

six_stage_inventory.route: 旧兵器架600tick→残损铁剑→流云剑+流派配饰；废弃军械3600tick→机括→钢索/连弩→重弩与弹药
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 导航/军令/科举/Boss等段首任务夹具逐项列出；两条真实互动收益进入后续原配方，流派备料任务先验后付款。

six_stage_inventory.route: 原镇岳刀→巨阙→青龙→玄武锻造进化链
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 仅原生连续付款与现有任务检测；关卡材料提供清单明确，不把QA材料当自然Boss掉落。

six_stage_inventory.route: 原胸甲分支连续制作→玄天/鸿蒙终点与原FTB物品目标
six_stage_inventory.proof_boundary: 原配方按真实前驱逐步消耗；终盘原料均标QA，既有前驱不得直接补发绕过链。真实终盘战斗/替换体验另验。

six_stage_evidence_note: All inherited six-stage QA/material-injected route entries remain historical fixture proof, not natural runs. This new route starts with opening only.
